title: Additives our record says the US FDA does not permit
standfirst: What one place does not permit, another may. Here is what the US FDA does not allow in food.

spans.text: Every additive named here is one our registry records as not permitted in food by the US FDA. That is a decision about the substance itself. It is not a claim about any food you are holding.

blocks.caption: Counted from each additive's own record of where it may not be used. Every additive in that count is named below.

resolved.limit: This is our record of a decision, not a reading of the law itself: we have not checked each additive against the text of the law. And where a law works by naming what may be used, an additive missing from this list is not thereby permitted — it may simply not be listed.

spans.text: A decision like this one is about whether a substance may be used in food at all, in the place that decided. It is not a ceiling on how much of it a food may contain.
The ones our record says the US FDA does not permit
A decision made in one place is not a decision made everywhere. Another regulator may still allow the same additive.

Our record of where an additive may not be used is a summary, not the law itself, and we have not checked each additive against the text of the law. And where a law works by naming what may be used, an additive missing from this list is not thereby permitted.
